list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Feat: add encrypted traffic flow monitor and Streamlit dashboard
- Add monitorTraffic.py: extracts flow features and TLS/QUIC metadata (SNI, fingerprints, packet size/timing stats) with NFStream from live capture or PCAP files - Score flows with Isolation Forest trained on a warmup baseline and log anomalies to alerts.jsonl - Add dashboard.py: Streamlit UI with summary metrics, score distribution, packets vs. bytes plot, top domains and anomaly alerts table
